mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when this trigger is met, or the median return is not significantly below zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,400K units signals weakening aggregate demand, which depresses corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below the median baseline at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit margins, which in turn leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods, or the trigger fires but the median return is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month MA for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the federal funds rate below 3% within a single month signals an emergency easing response to a financial shock, which boosts liquidity and supports equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS drops by >1.0 percentage point in one month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered events, or the trigger occurs but median return is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in real personal savings (RSAFS) and a fall in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter indicates a shift from spending to saving, which typically precedes a slowdown in demand and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below the baseline at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth above 0.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods, or the trigger fires but the median return is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) above their respective 12-month moving averages for two consecutive months signals a synchronized expansion in manufacturing and construction, which elevates corporate revenues and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 12-month MA AND HOUST > 12-month MA for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered episodes, or the joint trigger occurs but the median return is negative.
